`coalesce(jsonb_agg(...), '[]'::jsonb)` returns an empty array, which is a distinct state. The test for it is integration-marked and was not executed. No offline or web test covers the empty-history state.

A live PostgREST test exists, but it is integration-marked and no gate ran it. There is also no evidence that the history_read migration was applied to the live Supabase project, so the flagged assumption (one JSON array under the PostgREST row cap) is unverified.
